input.command:
cd /tmp && cat > smoke.py <<'EOF'
import requests, json
B = "http://localhost:8080"
def h(t): return {"Authorization": f"Bearer {t}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}

r = requests.post(f"{B}/api/auth/login", json={"username": "admin", "password": "admin123"})
print("login:", r.status_code, r.json().get("code") if r.ok else r.text)
tok = r.json()["data"]["token"]

# try operator too
r2 = requests.post(f"{B}/api/auth/login", json={"username": "operator", "password": "operator123"})
print("login2:", r2.status_code)

r = requests.post(f"{B}/api/instances", json={"name": "web-01", "ip": "10.0.0.1", "port": 8080, "description": "test"}, headers=h(tok))
print("create instance:", r.status_code, r.json())
iid = r.json()["data"]["id"]

resources = [
    {"resKey": "http-check", "conditionExpr": "#port == 8080", "urlExpr": "'http://' + #ip + ':' + #port + '/health'"},
    {"resKey": "skip-false", "conditionExpr": "#port > 9000", "urlExpr": "'http://x'"},
    {"resKey": "bad-cond", "conditionExpr": "#port === ", "urlExpr": "'http://y'"},
    {"resKey": "bad-url", "conditionExpr": "#name == 'web-01'", "urlExpr": "'http://' + #missingVar +"},
    {"resKey": "null-cond", "conditionExpr": "null", "urlExpr": "'http://z'"},
]
rids = []
for res in resources:
    r = requests.post(f"{B}/api/inspect-resources", json=res, headers=h(tok))
    print("create res:", r.status_code, r.json().get("data", {}).get("resKey"))
    rids.append(r.json()["data"]["id"])

r = requests.post(f"{B}/api/instances/{iid}/inspect", headers=h(tok))
print("inspect:", r.status_code)
print(json.dumps(r.json(), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))

r = requests.post(f"{B}/api/instances/99999/inspect", headers=h(tok))
print("inspect missing:", r.status_code, r.json())
EOF
python3 smoke.py
